title: Spring Portfolio Tasting
body:
Join us for a walk-around tasting of the spring portfolio, featuring new Burgundy and Rhône arrivals alongside familiar favorites. RSVP to reserve a spot — we expect a full room and want to make sure there's a pour waiting for you when you arrive.

Light bites will be served alongside the wines, and the full sales team will be on hand to answer questions about allocations for the coming season.
